dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Why do you need to do special training?

dialogues.speaker: Virda
dialogues.text: Well, to join the Marechaussee Phantom, of course. Monsieur Neuvillette says that we all have the potential to become Marechaussee agents...

dialogues.speaker: Virda
dialogues.text: But you have to undergo strict assessments to become a member for real, so I have to work hard!
